tasks.title: Init and day-2 commands share lock, safe-write, spawn and readiness helpers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Reuse (extract before the second use), shared files and Tool facts; Decisions 3, 4, 7 (container readiness/equality), 8 and 13 (durable state writes), Security impact and Rollout order. FIRST extract the owned .pulse-init.lock and atomicWrite/link/mode checks from cli/write-install.ts into tested cli/lock.ts and cli/safe-write.ts; migrate init before adding consumers. Preserve lock nonce/ownership and recorded signals, change refusal to 'another pulse command is running in <dir> (or remove .pulse-init.lock if none is)', and fsync both file and containing directory. safe-write.ts also owns the single validate-on-read/write-state-before-side-effect helper shared by rotation-journal and upgrade.json, including durable rename and archive finalization. Extend cli/docker.ts's only spawn seam for input, stdinFd and stdoutFd, preserving ignored stdin by default, bounded calls and Docker exit 3; distinguish missing binaries by name so missing gh can exit 1. Extend cli/ready.ts's parsePs with full ID and readyz/waitReady with container-id targeting rather than adding a poller. Implement constant API_SCRIPT (stdin JSON, fixed localhost URL, 10 s timeout, redirect error, 1 MiB response cap), status parsing and timingSafeEqual file comparison in cli/api-call.ts. Export/reuse own() from cli/docker.ts and assertPin/PULSE_IMAGE from cli/services.ts; services.ts and its tests are declared here because the section's Reuse paragraph explicitly requires them. Extend cli/test/fake-docker.ts as the only fake spawn, recording input, fds, signals, full container ids/states and a named stop-at-step hook for both later failure matrices. Every shared module states what it owns and tests its variants; no duplicate guards, pin patterns, spawns, state writers or readiness loops.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; .pulse-init.lock refuses a second owner and never removes a changed owner's lock; init preserves valid tokens/keys and records interrupts; writes use wx, final mode, file fsync, rename and directory fsync, refusing links and unsafe modes. State readers reject malformed literal fixtures and an injected fsync failure prevents the next side effect. Absent input keeps stdin ignored, input closes stdin, fd streams preserve literal bytes, and full 64-hex ps IDs select the intended container. API transport uses stdin only with 10 s/1 MiB/redirect:error; equality prints only same or different. Docker ENOENT remains exit 3 and missing gh is distinguished by name. The sole fake spawn records options/signals and its named hook stops the selected step. Focused coverage is not the coverage gate

tasks.title: pulse token rotate safely hands over local tokens and resumes interrupted rotations
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, rotation-journal, token-rotate, command wiring, api-call consumer checks and docs; Decisions 1 and 3-9; Required behavior (token rotate and Help and docs); Counterexamples (Selection, Order, Handoff resume, Lost answer, Journal resume, 409, Legacy api, Files, No secret in argv); Acceptance evidence 1 (production behavior), 3 (rotation matrix), 5-6; Security impact (rotation) and Rollout order. Extend cli/lock.ts, cli/safe-write.ts's shared state reader/writer, cli/api-call.ts, resolveProject/guarded, readyz/waitReady/parsePs, tokenContentValid, shown(), firstLine/maskUserInfo and cli/test/fake-docker.ts. Keep the journal and complete rotation algorithm together. Preflight every location, candidate, file and exactly-one ready consumer before any POST; record full oldContainerId before mutation. Implement all journal states requested/replacing/saved/refreshing/refreshed/handoff/switched/revoking/done, validation, activeTokenId/revokeTokenId/replacementName and old/new container IDs, with every state durable before its side effect. Save the received secret atomically 0600 before refresh; probe handoff follows the exact decision 8 observed-container resume table and never scales again when old plus new already exist. Wait for new readiness, same-token check and 2000 ms before stopping/removing only the old probe; handle no-running, failed-new, duplicate-new and repeated-different branches as specified. Admin identity succeeds before console recreate, readiness, equality and its own-file API identity check. Lost rotate answers compare rotatedAt before any retry; journal replacementName before create, revoke orphan replacements of that exact name before another create, save/switch the replacement then durably revoke the lost token, including interrupted switched/revoking recovery and confirmed-already-revoked replies. Preserve unrelated tokens and never discard a received secret. Record signals during critical API/state transitions; at boundaries exit 130 with journal retained. Parse admin|probe, selectors and journal-argument matching, timeout 1-3600 default 120; handle statuses 401/403/404/409/429 and malformed bodies safely. Wire HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch and errors.sh. Add command and Token recovery docs, replace manual rotation bullets, update pinned-release text, explain duplicates with the Performance formula, expired-admin and no-running recovery, standalone exclusions and manual equivalents. All unit failure-injection cases belong here; the real overlap/gap/resume job belongs to T6.
